mainEntity.name: Which is better: % of max or heart rate reserve?

acceptedAnswer.text: Heart rate reserve (Karvonen) is more personalized because it accounts for your resting heart rate, which drops as you get fitter. The % of max method is simpler and only needs your age.

mainEntity.name: How do I check my heart rate during exercise?

acceptedAnswer.text: Use a heart-rate monitor or watch, or stop briefly and count your pulse at the wrist or neck for 10 seconds, then multiply by 6. The pulse-check panel shows your 10-second targets.

mainEntity.name: What is a normal resting heart rate?

acceptedAnswer.text: For most adults it's between 60 and 100 beats per minute. Well-trained athletes often have lower resting rates. Check it in the morning before getting out of bed.
